results.title: Pound-to-Euro Forecast: UK GDP Looms For GBP Rates
results.content:
Written by: Adam Solomon Published: 11 Nov 2026, 06:00 GMT 2 min read 

## The Pound-Euro could remain subdued if Lagarde strikes a cautious tone, while Sterling may struggle for direction ahead of Thursday’s UK GDP data.

The Pound Euro (GBP/EUR) exchange rate slipped to an eight-day low on Tuesday as a pullback in French bond yields eased concerns about the country’s debt crisis.

At the time of writing, GBP/EUR was trading at €1.1962, marginally down on the day having bounced off an eight-day low of €1.1952.
